title: Starbloom Isles
tagline: Hop, bloom, and light the beacon across the floating sky.
pitch: Starbloom Isles: a bright, juicy toon 3D platformer. A little fox hops across floating sky islands, rope bridges and moving platforms collecting glowing star blooms, stomping grumpy slimes, and reaching the beacon portal on the last island. Cheerful, saturated, sunny.

plan.title: Starbloom Isles
plan.tagline: Hop, bloom, and light the beacon across the floating sky.
plan.core_loop: Hop between floating sky islands, time moving platforms and spring pads, stomp grumpy slimes, and bank star blooms on the way to the beacon portal on the last island.
plan.win_condition: Reach the beacon portal on the final island; star blooms collected are scored toward the 12-bloom target for a full-bloom finish.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives by falling into the void or getting hit by a slime.
plan.art_direction: Saturated candy-sky palette — azure, tangerine, cream — with cel-shaded toon surfaces, thick ink outlines and a soft warm rim light on every island edge. Materials read as glossy plastic and plush: rounded grass tufts, taut rope bridges, translucent glowing star blooms. Mood is sunny, weightless and joyful; references Skylanders meets Toon Blast, lit by a high warm sun with long soft shadows.
concept_shots: The fox mid-hop between two grassy sky islands, a rope bridge sagging below, a sparkling arc of star blooms ahead, fluffy clouds far underneath.
A grumpy green slime patrolling a stone platform as the fox lands on its head with a squash-and-stretch poof, star blooms popping into the air.
The final island: the tall beacon portal rings with light as the fox dashes in, confetti bursts and the HUD reads 12/12 Star Blooms.

features: Moving platforms that shuttle the fox across wide gaps between islands
Spring pads that launch the fox to the higher bloom-rich islands
Void below the islands — falling costs a life and respawns at the last checkpoint
Checkpoint flags at island midpoints so progress is never lost
Patrol slimes to stomp or dodge, with hit flash, squash and a poof on stomp
Beacon portal goal with a light ring, confetti burst and victory banner

result.summary: Starbloom Isles is a bright toon 3D platformer where a little fox with a teal scarf hops across floating sky islands, collects 24 star blooms (12 needed to unlock the beacon portal), stomps 4 patrol slimes, rides spring pads and moving platforms, and reaches the beacon portal on the final island. The game uses the generated sky panorama, star-bloom icon, heart icon, flag icon, ukulele music, and all 6 SFX (collect, jump, land, damage, win, lose). Voxel props (star shrooms, beacon lanterns) and Gaussian-splat landmarks are placed beside the route. Spring pads launch the fox up steep hops; spinner hazards sweep across flat gaps. The HUD shows star blooms collected (12/12 target), 3 hearts for lives, a minimap with route/checkpoints/goal, and the objective. The title screen sells the fantasy with the tagline and controls. Win triggers confetti, star burst, and a "win" emote; lose triggers a dark red vignette and "sad" emote. Autopilot verified: full run from spawn to goal, 21 stars collected, 2 enemies stomped, won=true, zero errors.
changes: Switched player from default kid to fox species with teal scarf and plan colors (#ff8a3d body, #fff1d6 accent)
Added spring_pad props + bounce hazards at steep route hops (up to 3, auto-placed)
Added spinner hazards on flat mid-route gaps (up to 2, auto-placed)
Added onWin callback: confetti (220 particles, plan palette), star burst at goal, win emote
Added onLose callback: dark red vignette flash, sad emote
Added stomp event FX: green poof + 'STOMP!' floating text
Added goal event FX: golden ring shockwave at the portal
Added goalLocked toast: tells player how many more star blooms are needed
Tuned HUD objective text to 'Collect 12 Star Blooms, then reach the beacon'
Kept generated voxel props (star shrooms, beacon lanterns) and Gaussian-splat landmarks beside the route
known_issues: THREE.WebGLProgram signed/unsigned mismatch warning (harmless, from three.js shader compilation)
Autopilot took 2 hits from slimes during the run (hp went 3→1) but still won; this is expected gameplay
